site.title: The desktop
site.description: Windows stack and snap, the day's routines hang across the top, and the search bar waits at the bottom of every screen.
site.alt: The JawnOS desktop with several app windows open, a row of routine buttons along the top and a search bar at the bottom.

site.title: Handbook
site.description: Today at a glance: money, the state of life, the day's records and what they predict.
site.alt: The JawnOS Handbook for Tuesday, 27 October 2026, showing money spent, state of life, the day's records and what the records predict.

site.title: Measures
site.description: Units and formulas, converted in place — currencies, temperatures, lengths and more.
site.alt: The JawnOS Measures table, listing power, temperature, currency and volume conversions with their formulas.

site.title: The whole picture
site.description: Routines, people and things as connected nodes, split across two columns.
site.alt: A two-column map of routines, people and things, drawn as connected nodes over the desktop.

site.title: Warehouse
site.description: Levels, quantities and a search across everything in the house.
site.alt: The JawnOS Warehouse listing accounts and stocked items, from paper and canvas to coffee and packing tape.

site.title: Files
site.description: A folder grid with sizes, free space and a machine picker.
site.alt: The JawnOS Files window showing folders in the home directory, including Desktop, Documents, Music, Pictures, Templates and Videos.

site.title: Clock
site.description: Alarms, stopwatch, timer and world clock in one window.
site.alt: The JawnOS Clock app with three alarms, each with a switch.

site.title: Synth
site.description: A playable synth, a filter and a step sequencer, with the MIDI device picker.
site.alt: The JawnOS Synth app with a piano keyboard, effect sliders and a 16-step sequencer.

site.title: Studio
site.description: Four tracks, a transport, a tempo wheel and the synth patched in above.
site.alt: The JawnOS Studio with four recording tracks, transport controls, a tempo wheel and the synth above them.

site.title: Sage
site.description: The Sage theme: green paper, soft corners and the whole stack of windows.
site.alt: A stack of JawnOS windows over the Sage theme's pale green paper background.

site.title: Light scheme
site.description: Windows in a stack over a plain, bright desktop.
site.alt: Cascading JawnOS windows on a plain light desktop, with a column of linked labels on the right.

site.title: Wallpaper
site.description: A photograph behind the windows, with the palette to match.
site.alt: The JawnOS desktop over a soft, blurred photographic wallpaper, with the Files window open.
